title: Qwen-Image-Edit (stable-diffusion.cpp) start parameters
description: Start-time configuration only. These values are substituted into the launch command and decide how the child process reads its weights, so changing any of them restarts the arm. Per-generation values (prompt, size, steps, seed, batch, reference images) are sent to the running arm as a job and are validated by the arm itself.

diffusionModel.description: Qwen-Image-Edit transformer in GGUF, relative to the managed storage directory. The quantisation is the main VRAM lever: Q4_K_M is around 12 GiB, Q8_0 roughly double that and will not stay resident on a 16 GiB card.

vae.description: Qwen-Image VAE, relative to the managed storage directory. Shared by every Qwen-Image-Edit release; it is not quantised.

llm.description: Qwen2.5-VL text encoder, relative to the managed storage directory. May be a .safetensors file or a GGUF; a GGUF needs llmVision alongside it.

llmVision.description: Vision tower for a GGUF text encoder (an mmproj file), relative to the managed storage directory. Ignored when the file is not there, which is the normal case with the .safetensors encoder: it carries its own. A launch placeholder cannot be omitted conditionally, so this always has a value and the arm decides whether it applies.

outputDir.description: Root for generated files, relative to the managed storage directory. Every job output path is resolved inside it and anything that escapes is rejected by the arm.

inputDir.description: Root that a job's reference images are resolved inside, relative to the managed storage directory. Separate from outputDir because a job supplies these paths and the arm reads them.

offloadToCpu.description: Keep weights in host RAM and move them to the card as they are needed. On a 16 GiB card this is what makes a 12 GiB transformer plus an 8 GiB text encoder fit at all; turn it off only if both fit outright, where it costs nothing to leave them there.

flashAttention.description: The child's --diffusion-fa. Flash attention in the diffusion model, which cuts the attention activation peak; upstream's own Qwen-Image-Edit examples all enable it.

threads.description: CPU threads for the parts that run on the host. -1 lets the child choose, which is the physical core count.

modelArgs.description: Passed to the child's --model-args verbatim. The default is what upstream requires for Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 specifically; on 2509 or the original Edit release, clear it.
